title: Robust Persona-Aware Toxicity Detection with Prompt Optimization and Learned Ensembling

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance in subjective toxicity detection by prompting LLMs to adopt specific racial personas (combined with gender, e.g., Asian, Black, White, Hispanic, Native) and comparing their predictions against ground-truth annotations from human raters of those same demographic groups using the Social Bias Frames dataset.

Evaluating model performance in subjective toxicity detection by prompting LLMs to adopt specific gendered personas (combined with race, e.g., Woman, Man) and comparing their predictions against ground-truth annotations from human raters of those same demographic groups using the Social Bias Frames dataset.
